Each gold reading is checked by classify_request's own validator against those sources, so it names each one by its id. Periods are given in a form that holds on any day; absolute dates assume today is 2026-10-08. Labels: the 48 scratch cases carry Claude's labels (claude-opus-5-5) and a second opinion from Codex (gpt-6-astra, codex-cli 0.145.0) given in one call over all 48, text only, on the last turn alone; agreed is true where the two match on kind and on deliverable, an answer, a record or coordination taking none. The 74 routing cases (written by Claude Fable 5.1 on 2026-09-02) and every authored case (written by Claude, claude-opus-5-5, on 2026-10-08) carry Claude's labels only, so agreed is false on them until a Codex labeling pass is merged.
